justification: Changes what a property page says about setback numbers. A false warning over-warns (fail closed); a missing warning lets numbers vanish unexplained, which is the bug. Not Critical: no write, no change to which numbers are served. Not Minor: user-facing wording on a compliance surface.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_chapter_registry.needs_extraction (set by r2_monitor on a source change) and dcp_setback_controls.needs_review (rows excluded at scripts/conveyancing_db.py:677-686). Measured 2026-10-22 read-only: bayside 2 and canterbury_bankstown 9 current rows withheld; canterbury_bankstown 3 chapters flagged after today's monitor run.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The plan assumed the existing 'Amendment detected' line covered every council. It renders only after ProvisionsByTocStructure's early return (:1548), which a council with zero provisions never passes, so setback-only councils got nothing.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies on deploy. canterbury_bankstown shows the warning at once (3 flagged chapters, 9 withheld rows); bayside shows '2 controls are held back'.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: review_status is dropped from either response, a failed check reads as nothing pending, the needs_extraction / is_current filters are loosened, the count is hidden, or the unknown state is silent, or a row held for a non-amendment reason is called an amendment
falsifiable_check.observed_red: YES, 10 mutants applied one at a time, each killed: both response branches dropping review_status, error returning {false,0}, needs_extraction IS NOT NULL, is_current dropped, count not coerced, null state silent, withheld-only hidden, count not shown, fallback removed. Restored green. Second round after cross-review, 5 more killed: source-change count taking every reason, NULL reason dropped from the other count, other reasons called an amendment, other-only hidden, other count not shown.

functions.name: fetchDcpReviewStatus
functions.input: the council slugs returned by getLgaSlugs for this request
functions.output: an object with amendment_pending and withheld_controls, or null
functions.if_none: no slugs or any DB error -> null (unknown), never {false,0}

functions.name: ReviewNotice
functions.input: the review_status field taken from the structured-controls response
functions.output: amber warning, 'could not check' line, or nothing
functions.if_none: undefined (older backend) -> nothing; null -> says it could not check

values.if_missing: absent = nothing shown; null = 'could not check' shown

queries.purpose: tell the setback panel whether this council has a source change waiting for review and how many numbers are withheld
queries.where_clause: council = ANY($1) AND is_active AND needs_extraction; lga = ANY($1) AND is_current AND needs_review split by review_reason = 'chapter_pdf_changed' vs IS DISTINCT FROM

break_it.scenario: Every setback row of a council is withheld (bayside after its new edition is flagged)
break_it.what_happens: has_controls false; the empty branch still shows 'Amendment detected — 42 controls are held back'
break_it.how: review_status on the empty response + notice in every branch
break_it.repro: structured-controls carries review_status > when every row was withheld

break_it.scenario: The review status database query fails or times out
break_it.what_happens: panel says it could not check; controls still served
break_it.repro: a failed check is sent as null, not dropped

break_it.scenario: Frontend deploys before/after a backend without the field
break_it.what_happens: no extra line is shown on the panel
break_it.repro: an older backend without the field shows nothing

break_it.scenario: A setback row is held back because our number did not match the council's document (114 of 192 measured 2026-10-22)
break_it.what_happens: the panel says it is held back until checked against the council's plan, and does not say an amendment was detected
break_it.how: withheld_source_changed counts only review_reason = 'chapter_pdf_changed'; everything else is withheld_other
break_it.repro: rows held for another reason are NEVER called an amendment

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes -- load a canterbury_bankstown and a bayside address on prod; the setback panel shows the amber line.
